title: Apollo 13: reframe the mission after a loss
focus: Separate the original mission objective, the survival objective, and the resources that make a new operating concept feasible.

sources.title: Apollo 13 Mission Report, MSC-02680
sources.locator: Summary and sections on spacecraft performance and anomalies
sources.limitations: The currently public NTRS record distributes a report whose original cover describes an internal working report. The gallery uses its mission findings, not a claim of an approved modern procedure.

facts.statement: The planned lunar landing was abandoned following loss of service-module cryogenic oxygen; the lunar module supplied life support and power during the return.
The command module was retained for Earth entry while the lunar module supported the crew before separation.

retrospective.boundary: Crew, both spacecraft modules, consumables, ground teams, communications, trajectory, and recovery forces form the return system.
interfaces: Lunar module → crew: consumable capacity depends on duration and demand, not merely cabin occupancy.
Ground team → crew: revised procedures compete for crew attention and need configuration control.

decision.question: How should a team choose a new objective when the nominal mission is no longer feasible?
options: Continue optimizing the original science plan.
Establish a return objective, protected resources, and a controlled sequence of mode changes.
decision.recommendation: Use a jointly maintained resource and mode ledger before optimizing individual subsystems.
decision.uncertainty: A plausible return sequence still needs time-dependent margins, operational rehearsal, and authoritative flight decisions.

rows: Consumption estimates, uncertainty, and observed trend
Protect equipment needed after module separation
Issue one controlled sequence with acknowledged revisions
Crew readback and ground configuration agreement

questions: Which original requirements remain binding after the objective changes?
How could saving power locally increase risk during entry preparation?
Give a 60-second status message distinguishing observed resources from predicted margin.
answer_signals: Names survival constraints and explicitly retires obsolete mission goals.
Connects subsystem conservation to later modes and interfaces.
Reports uncertainty and the next discriminating observation.
retrospective.transfer_exercise: Synthetic: a remote habitat loses its primary power source. Draft a 12-hour resource ledger and identify the assumption that most threatens return to normal operation.
retrospective.limits: The ledger is newly authored. No Apollo trajectory, consumable, or crew-procedure simulation was performed.
